Il Libro Finto

Canto I

  • Il sole non brilla mai
    sopra il tetto della zuppa
    quando il gatto dorme.
    • The sun never shines
      above the roof of the soup
      when the cat sleeps.
    • Lines 1–3 (tr. A. Nobody)
  • La luna beve il tè.
    • The moon drinks the tea.
    • Line 4 (tr. A. Nobody)
    • Some editions read "coffee".
  • Il gatto sogna la zuppa.
    • Lines 6–7
    • The cat dreams of soup.
      (tr. Nobody)
    • The cat is dreaming of the soup.
      (tr. B. Somebody)
  • An English line that was never in italics.
    • Line 5
